avis.texte: For a product thats meant to hydrate, it did the opposite for me. My skin immediately felt dry and tight.

I usually love Naturium products, so when I needed to get more hyaluronic acid serum I was excited to try this, but after about 4-5 days of use, I realized this was giving me pimples all over ans red itchy bumps. If you have sensitive skin, I would avoid
Anything from Naturium is a win! Very good hydrating serum at a great price point.
In Love About A Week Later. Very Hydrating! I Usually Use Good Molecules HA Which Is Good As Well But Its Something Different About This One, I Like It!
I love all of their products however this one made me break out like a teenager.
This is the best formulation I've used for hyaluronic acid. You can immediately see and feel the hydrating effects.

I am 38 years old and just starting to see some fine lines. I have also been struggling with VERY dry, dehydrated, and sensitive skin. Ive been using this for 2 weeks now and wow- huge difference! My skin is so hydrated and I definitely think that it looks plumper and younger. Big fan of this stuff. Oh, and I LOVE that its fragrance free. No irritation whatsoever!
Love this! Does not leave my skin feeling sticky. My skin absorbs it very well

This has been my favorite HA serum. I've been using it for a few years now and i've repurchased many times. It's hydrating and lightweight and never sticky. It absorbs nicely to give a nice canvas for the rest of your skincare.
I love this serum I use it before retinol at night and it my skin has been very happy. It's a simple way to add more hydration. It absorbs quickly alllowing you to layer with out products.

Amazing consistency, not sticky like some other brands that I've tried. I use it right after I wash my face/after spraying a toner and right before moisturizing. I can definitely see the difference in hydration levels when using this. I've already reordered once I emptied the first one :)
I really like the Hyaluronic Serum. It goes on so nice and smooth and makes my face so soft. I have used other brands, but this is my favorite.
i love using this at night before my night moisturizer, and it absorbs so well. the texture is so nice and light, and doesn't have much of a scent

avis.titre: Still waiting for all the hydration
avis.texte: Not too impressed. Skin fees sticky after use. Feel like I have to use a lot

avis.titre: Best hialuronic acid serum I've tried
avis.texte: I'm a makeup artist and use it on all of my clients followed by the multi peptide moisturizer. Foundation glides effortlessly and gives skin a fresh and healthy glow. Def will be my kit staples from now on.
Honestly the stuff I normally use from her works fantastic I tried this and it broke me out
Haven't noticed a difference...yet. Working my way up to day/night...only using at night.
I've tried many HA serums and this one is my favorite. One pump is all I need and in conjunction with the other products I use, my face is hydrated all day!
I bought this on a whim, as I've been using the essence for awhile. I love it! It goes on really well and my sensitive and dry skin feels awesome all day. Highly recommend.

This serum is incredible. I feel my skin really holding onto moisture significantly more since incorporating it into my routine—my skin feels like it expands in holding onto the moisture in the best way. You should put on while your skin is damp. Great, especially for the price. Highly recommend.
I love the product. The only negative is the delivery system. When you get to the end of the product I have to unscrew the pump shake out the product or wipe the pump tub on my hand. Please fix!!!
I found my more expensive HA (Dr. Jart) to plump my skin more.
love it during humid weather. i was scared it would break me out but i have been using it for 2 weeks and my skin loved it. definitely recommend
Like the feel with nighttime use - definitely the best I have used and far less the cost.
I love all of the products I purchased. I even received a compliment on the looks of my skin.
I've been using this at night with the Niacinamide serum. I no longer have dry spots.

This serum was sticky, and didn't even take long before it broke me. I have oily skin was looking for a product that help with hydration and reduce my dehydration-induced oiliness. Unfortunately, this product didn't work out. Not only that, but upon returning the item, I had to pay for shipping and wouldn't be getting back the original shipping cost in my return. I was also told that if a discount code is used, products are ineligible for return, but that they'd made an "exception".

avis.titre: Who doesn't need a hydrating serum in their life?
avis.texte: It's a soothing hyaluronic acid serum. Pairs with everything. Can't really go wrong with this one.
It's an amazing product I saw and felt a difference in my skin since the first use

I use this in my nighttime routine and after just a week I noticed a difference in my skins hydration! I wake up to soft plump skin that feels and looks extremely noticeable. I live in the desert and hydration is a must, and this definitely helped to improve my skin!

Its texture is super light as its formulation says, however I don't like it very much because I feel that it does not hydrate me enough and does not leave that intense glow that HA usually leaves, if it leaves the skin soft but I do not feel that it is my favorite .
I love this serum. Sometimes my nighttime routine can get a little heavy so I like to use this in place of the hyaluronic acid gel cream. It works like a dream.
Absolutely LOVE this product. Has become a staple in my routine. Depending on need, I switch-up my moisturizer - yet this serum seamlessly can be used under each of them.

I am slowly getting into this. In the past hyaluronic have irritated my skin. I am oily and sensitive and I tend to get bumps from it. So far so good. I do not use this every day and when I do it's at night. It has a nice texture though
I love the pump bottle that this comes in, I prefer it over the dropper bottles! Also, I love the thickness and consistency of this hyaluronic acid. Will definitely purchase again!

I just finished my first bottle of the quadruple hyaluronic acid serum and I can honestly say that I loved it! The formulation is smooth and soothing making it glide right over your skin as you apply it. It absorbs quickly but more slowly than the hyaluronic acid serum that I tried from The Ordinary. I believe this is due to the formulation and I liked the difference because I didn't feel rushed to quickly get to my next step to avoid my skin starting to dry. I have combination skin with a very oily forehead and an easily irritated and dry naso-labial area. The lower face sensitivity is new post-pregnancy and my skin was drying to the point of constant flaking while my forehead was a pure oil slick. I used this serum on my lower face and the niacinamide gel cream on my forehead... Miracles. That's it. My lower face is now holding moisture all day and no more embarrassing flakes! Love this serum.

Goes on nice and smooth, not sticky, not overly fragrant, and feels hydrating like it's not just sitting on top of my face. Layers well with my other skincare! Very pleased and nice price. Pump is also nice and I appreciate the design and feel of the bottle.

I wanted this to be better than it was. Still doesn't beat the PTR hyaluronic acid. For all of Susan Yara's talk of expensive hyaluronic acids are unnecessary, this product compared to the PTR proves that you do indeed get what you pay for.
Good quality hyaluronic acid for the price. Like the pump bottle.
With how picky Susan Yara is about her serums, this surprised me. It goes sticky and doesn't absorb well. Felt like lube on my face. There are several drug store brands I like better.
Leaves my skin feeling moist and supple compared to other HA serums I use.

I love this serum! My skin has always been dry to the bone and I am always on the hunt for moisture in every skincare product I use. This HA serum is a game-changer. I added it into my morning routine and my skin feels so soft and hydrated all day long. I love the price point of Naturium products and the formulations. They actually work!
It's very hydrating and does not leave a sticky residue on my skin! This bottle lasted me three months and for the price I highly recommend.
My skin has never looked better sense using this product, it's soft, plumper and glowing.
Love this serum. It feels luxurious and smells clean. I love the feel on my skin and keep my combo-dry skin moisturized all day.
I found that my skin was getting dry as a result of using actives however, the Quadruple Hyaluronic Acid Serum was the perfect solution. Now, my skin looks smooth and plump. Thank you!
My skin is already so much more clear and less oily from the added hydration!
So far, I have found that this Hyaluronic product provides soothing moisture to my face.

I honestly think this is a good dupe for drunk elephants b-hydra because it has a similar consistency (Naturium's may be a little thicker but I like that about it). It also lasts me a long time because I usually only use it in the evening
just a really good HA serum. sinks into the skin really well and has helped my skin so much. layers really well with other skincare.
This has definitely helped with the dark spots and evens out my skin

The most amazing thing to come into my life. I like to wear lighter weight moisturizers during the day but my skin feels dry and tight and will burn by the end of the day, but thick moisturizers during the day make me feel heavy and greasy. I started using this and OH MY GOSH. My skin feels amazing, lightweight, and I can put this on before lightweight moisturizers and my face feels amazing all day long! I've noticed an improvement in my overall skin health since I started using this!

avis.titre: Exactly what I needed in my routine!
avis.texte: My skin has felt very dry and agitated and this serum under by vitamin c serum in the morning really calms down my skin!
It's what it is supposed to be, a good hydration serum I love it. It does the job. Also have to point out that the price is fair I believe. Repurchased and I will do again

I'm in love with this serum. It does such a great job hydrating my combination skin. I really did notice a difference overnight. The consistency is perfect. So easy to implement into your routine. Definitely will be repurchasing!

avis.titre: You need to give this product a chance!
avis.texte: I bought this product frim Target. I have not had good experiences with hyralonic acid serums such as the Vichy mineral 89 and peach&lily's glass skin. These two serums literally just sit on top of your skin and builds a film. Naturium's product actually sinks into your skin providing a nice base to skincare. The best way to use this product is to apply it to damp or wet skin since hyralonic acid will want to draw in moisture. I let it dry and then I use the rest of my skincare. I'm impressed with this item! Totally worth it.
Been using this product for two weeks and I'm enjoying it. Waiting to see results.
Intense over night moisturizer! Love love !the rich , the plant ceramide moisturizer is one of my favorites ! Yes

avis.titre: Love this better than my Skinceuticals!
avis.texte: This serum is amazing. So smooth, absorbs easily with-out a sticky feeling and you can honestly see instant results in skins appearance. It is my first active ingredient morning and night now. Love!!
This blend, whatever it is, is amazing. I really love it. My skin drinks it right up and feels so supple after.

I have sensitive skin, therefore I wanted to slowly introduce this product to my skincare. After using it the second time I saw red breakouts all over my face. I stopped using it and after about a week my skin was back to normal.

I have dry skin and use the Plant Ceramide cream (which I also love). Even with the cream and other measures to address dryness it wasn't quite enough. Adding this in at night before the cream has made ALL the difference. My skin is soft and supple in the mornings and not dry!
Love this I use it at night before bed and i notice when I wake up in the morning my skin feels hydrated and not red or irritated

This was the very first HA serum I've ever used and it's super. I have oily skin, but this doesn't make it greasy and absorbs quickly. I live in a state that gets pretty cold in the winter, and its been a skinlifesaver. If you need or want to try hyaluronic acid, this is a good one.
I used 4x / week for the last month and saw that the size of my pores has decreased dramatically! This is the first product ever that actually works! Highly recommend
It is hydrating and not sticky like other Hylauronic acids can be.
Does the job! I'm more of a fan or essences or thicker serums, but this is nice and thin and great for layering. No complaints!

I tried this company because of the good reviews I heard/read but, to be honest, my expectations were low. I was surprisingly proved wrong with this vitamin C serum. First of all, I appreciate the packaging; a pump is much easier and cleaner than a dropper. Second of all, the product itself was a trooper and helper this winter. Where I live has been colder than usual and masks have sucked all moisture from my face. This serum has helped keep my face moisturized for most of my work day, which is important to me. I would also like to mention that there was no irritation whatsoever. I plan on purchasing this again! For reference I have dry skin (very dry in the wintertime) with sensitivity at times.
I love that there are four types of HA in this serum. I use it as the first step after washing and essence.

With the dry winters in LA and wearing a mask often, this product has changed the game and has really helped with dryness, which i don't experience often because I have comb/oily skin. I use right after the shower for extra hydration. Also, I use retin-a from my derm. and using this serum helps with the sensitivity. 10/10

Had flaky dry winter skin, now I don't! Regimen includes: retinol, then serum, moisturizer, Argan oil and voila! Only change was the addition of this serum and I love it. Reordered already since my husband got into it as well. Thanks Naturium!

avis.titre: Best hyaluronic acid serum I've tried
avis.texte: I've tried a few different types of serums and this is by far my favorite. It isn't sticky and it's hydrating without feeling heavy on the skin. Really helps making sure my oily/acne-prone skin remains balanced throughout the day!

I got this the first days of February and got me through the coldest days of winter without my skin being flaky, I have rosacea so sometimes my skin is good and sometimes really bad, this has helped a lot with my hydration during this time.
This serum is great and does the job nicely. I enjoy using it in my nighttime routine. Overall, this is a game changer for my dry skin.

So I have oily skin even in the winter but I get so dehydrated. I must admit it took me a couple months to open this and start using it because I didn't think it would benefit me. I started using this on top of my essence and it's boosted hydration so nicely and doesn't feel sticky at all! I love this serum!
Straight forward serum, feels amazing on the skin and love that it's unscented and very gentle. My new go-to hyaluronic acid for sure.

I rarely write reviews BUT this product is worth gushing over. Ive been experiencing winter skin and breaking out because of it. I started using this and within three days my skin looks amazing! Will definitely be a new staple.
This is a great hyaluronic acid serum for a great price. Pairing this with squalane at night, makes my skin plump and glowing in the morning!
I never got the product, nor a phone number to get any answers..
Honestly one of the best Hyaluronic Acid Serums I've ever used! I will never not have this on hand!

I wasn't even able to use the product! Someone needs to work on packaging. I wish there was a period after opening symbol on all Naturium products. My HA serum broke after it was knocked off my vanity. Didn't have a chance to try it. Anyone who has children, a pet, or is clumsy like me will know how easy it is to knock over a tall glass bottle with a skinny base. I love the eco-friendly glass, but please change the shape of your bottles. The retinol cream is in plastic too! Either is a safer option. It's too bad because I loved consistency of the product, but I couldn't salvage it with the flecks of glass in it.
The different molecular weights of HA provide the most luxurious experience, will definitely be repurchasing!!!
I am new to Naturium but this product has made my skin feel so plump and hydrated without feeling greasy. I love it

I can not say enough good things about this product. It's affordable. It's a wonderful conduit for my serums and moisturizer, and it's highly effectively! I'm definitely a fan of the Naturium brand!❤️ My results have encouraged family and friends to purchase products.
Love this product, I have uneven dehydrated skin and this has worked well for my skin. Can't wait to keep trying more of these products.
So happy to see this in a pump bottle versus dropper-great product + improved delivery system = repeat buys

I've been using it for a week and so far seeing good results. Happy to have started my skin routine using Naturium, they are suited for my skin, no adverse reactions. I love seeing my skin getting better each day.
Amen for a non sticky Hyaluronic Acid Serum . I love putting this on my skin every night. Love the packing and the colors- Naturium is the bomb dot com!
I have very dry skin and I always love to have hylaronic acid in my routine. I really liked this one because it was very hydrating and didn't leave my skin sticky. Love it!!
I have acne prone, oily, reactive, sensitive skin and I went through the first bottle so fast I order 4 more just like it! I use this religiously! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!
my favorite serum I'm totally obsessed and I'm always stocked up :)
Definitely a staple product for the colder weather. Makes my skin feel plump and hydrated
I love this serum! The only thing is that it runs out so quickly and it would be nice to have a semi-transparent packaging so I know when to restock.
I can feel it soaking into my skin, by far my favorite serum!

I had previously been using The Ordinary HA however I was looking for something more hydrating and supple. This has been really great and giving bounce into my skin and it's really lightweight and it goes on smoothly. It's not sticky like traditional serums and that's why I love it so much.
It was nice. Honestly, from this I have realised I prefer formulas that are more well rounded rather than focusing on a single ingredient as they do more, in my opinion. Nice though!
I love all Naturium products so much. This serum feels great on the skin and goes on smooth. It makes me glow!
too thick, therefore suitable only for a night hydration boost

avis.titre: Didn't Know How Much I Needed It
avis.texte: This is my first hyaluronic acid serum, and I didn't realize how much of a difference it would make to my skin since most of my other products already contain this ingredient. But adding this serum into my regular nightly routine has improved my skins hydration SO MUCH! This is in term helped my maskne and help my skin repair itself. Definitely recommend.

This is a great serum! It goes on smoothly, my skin doesn't react to it, and I feel like it's significantly helped with my dry skin texture. My skin was even dehydrated for a while, and this serum helped bring it back to life! Highly recommend - especially if you have dry skin!

I've always been on the fence with hyaluronic acid serums as they never felt hydrating enough, but this one is great! My skin doesn't feel tight and thirsty after applying it, instead it's soft and plumped. Glad to see they changed the bottle - I still have the one with the dropper and, as the serum is thick, it is hard to get it out - a pump seems like it would function a lot better!
So far I'm really enjoying the way it makes my skin feel and it's making it look way more hydrated
It feels really nice on the skin, has made me less oily, and I think it has lightened some of my dark spots.

I use this serum faithfully every morning and every night! With wearing masks everyday and the weather getting cooler, I'm clinging to anything that will help keep my skin hydrated and this one is my favorite!

Where to start? First off the product itself is amazing. It's lightweight and hydrating. It layers wonderfully with my Niacinamide and vitamin C as well as my SPF 50. It's gentle enough for around the eyes and a staple in my self care routine! Also, I must add that the glass bottle and pump really make me happy! The biodegradable packaging and clever boxes really seal the deal! 10 out of 10, I will be a forever client.
Love this product! Keeps your skin hydrated without making you look "oily" or "shiny"

I loved this serum. I have sensitive, acne prone (hormonal) skin that waivers between combo-dry. Heavy moisturizers are not the best option for my given my acne, so I am always on the hunt for a hydrating serum to help my dry skin areas. This is better than the more expensive ones I've tried (skin ceuticals, drunk elephant). I actually noticed a difference in my skin's plumpness and overall hydration, and it didn't irritate or trigger any acne or sensitivity at all. I'm now trying out the essence and love that too. This one is best if you want something with a little more kick to it though.
I don't believe I will buy this product again. It is so difficult to get any of the product out of the bottle. I have to literally tilt it over to pour on my hand.
You know it's good when you convince your husband to use it after he took off all his Halloween face paint and commented on how great his skin felt the next morning!
Really hydrates your skin. Have noticed a big difference in the smoothness and hydration of my skin.

The Hylauronic Acid Serum and Niacinimide Serum are absolutely amazing! They feel so great on the skin and makes my skin feel so smooth and hydrated :-). I would LOVE to see a light moisturizer lotion with Ceramides, Niacinimide and HA :-). Also a Peptide serum would be awesome as well! :-)
Great serum not sticky at all. My face fells hydrated after use.

I have struggled with very dry skin since my son was born, 6 years ago. I've used numerous HA serums that only seemed to help for a few minutes or required follow up with heavy duty occlusives, not this one! This is a miracle for my skin. Where I once applied HA twice a day, this I only need in the morning. And dare I say it, sometimes I can skip a day. And it's just so wearable, it doesn't leave my skin sticky or overly dewy. Just plump and beautifully hydrated.

Although I think this is a fine HA serum, the dropper is the worst I have ever used. I also purchased another naturism product with a dropper and that one also struggles to get any product out of the container. I even emailed the company asking if I got a defective one, but no such luck. For this reason alone, I will likely not repurchase any of the serums that have a dropper.

avis.titre: Did We Just Become Best Friends?!
avis.texte: This product is my second half. As someone that has dry skin I can't rave enough about it. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, no fragrance and has me immediately feeling plump and hydrated. For the price you can't beat it. I love it and will never go a night without it.

avis.titre: Love the serum but the container is not good
avis.texte: So *when* I'm actually able to get product out of the bottle, it's great. But every time my dropper doesn't fill up at all and then when I try to close it the product spits EVERYWHERE. It's just such a mess I don't think I will be able to repurchase because I'm not able to really use it without making a huge fuss. Maybe mine is just defective. The dropper is fine with the other formulas but this hyaluronic acid just seems too thick for this type of dropper. Unfortunately, unless there's a change in packaging or mine was defective, I think I wasted my money.
